links.outcome: Readability (Flesch-Kincaid) of LLM-generated IPF medical information
links.effect: Both ChatGPT-4 and Gemini 1.5 Pro responses were rated difficult to understand on readability evaluations.
links.quote: Readability analyses found that AI-generated medical information was difficult to understand, stressing the need to refine it.

links.outcome: Concordance of LLM answers with ATS/ERS/JRS/ALAT IPF guidelines (0-4 scale)
links.effect: Gemini higher than ChatGPT-4: median 3.0 [3.0-3.5] vs 3.0 [2.5-3.0], p=0.0029; neither model fully concordant with guidelines.
links.quote: Nevertheless, neither model provided answers in full concordance with established clinical guidelines, and their readability remained a major challenge.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates the quality, reliability, readability, and guideline concordance of ChatGPT-4 and Gemini 1.5 Pro on idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis clinical questions without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
